data.title: Dismantle Base issue | Whole base dismantles! | Feedback Tracker
data.description: What happened? When a player has dismantled a section of their base (watchtower floor) the whole base dismantles! This is on Xbox Community. This Requires urgent action to be resolved before you start to loose players playing the game as people spend days and days building for this bug to just make it despawn in one action.
